units.source_text: 信辅的朋友用香烟盒里的银色纸包着一枚铜币，然后猛一转身用力把铜币扔了出去。

en.t: Shinsuke's friend wrapped a copper coin in the silver paper from a cigarette box, then suddenly turned around and flung it away with all his strength.

units.source_text: 铜币闪闪发光，掉进了波涛汹涌的大海里。

en.t: The copper coin glittered as it fell into the surging sea.

units.source_text: 就在那一刹那，海女抢先跳进了海里。

en.t: At that very instant, the ama diver leapt into the sea ahead of the others.

units.source_text: 信辅直到现在，还清楚的记得他的朋友的嘴角浮现出的残忍笑容。

en.t: Even now, Shinsuke still clearly remembered the cruel smile that had appeared at the corners of his friend's mouth.

units.source_text: 他的朋友拥有过人的外语才能。

en.t: His friend possessed an extraordinary talent for foreign languages.

units.source_text: 但是，他也确实有过人的尖利的犬齿……

en.t: But he also certainly had extraordinarily sharp canine teeth...
